items.summary: It's everywhere on social media: Democrats celebrating the attractive men voters elected in the midterms. But it's bigger than a meme and says a lot about politics of masculinity in the age of Trump.

items.title: Migrant caravan heads to US from Mexico after Democrats’ midterm win
items.summary: A migrant caravan of more than a thousand people is heading towards the US border from southern Mexico.

items.title: Netanyahu may fall, but his far-right legacy in Israel is going nowhere
items.summary: Israel’s far-right is accused of embedding a hardline agenda so deeply that reversing it may prove almost impossible.

items.title: Pochettino bids emotional farewell to US football ahead of Man Utd move
items.summary: Mauricio Pochettino has bid an emotional farewell to US football as he prepares to take charge of Manchester United.

items.title: Qatar and Turkiye sign a mutual defence pact: What do we know?
items.summary: Analysts say the pact, agreed amid the US-Iran war, aims to deter attacks rather than build an offensive alliance.

items.title: Hungary: Millions in hidden cash found in Orban graft probe
items.summary: Investigators discovered bundles of banknotes buried in forests and concealed in buildings. The money was seized during an investigation into a former minister accused of accepting millions in bribes.

items.title: US loses measles-elimination status after 26 years, WSJ reports
items.summary: The Pan American Health Organization has reportedly stripped the US of its measles-elimination status after 26 years, as the country battles its worst outbreaks in more than three decades.

items.title: Nearly $20m found in Hungary’s forests, buildings amid corruption probe
items.summary: An ex-minister faces a bribery probe as Hungary's new government investigates alleged corruption during Orban's rule.

items.title: Microsoft says all services working again
items.summary: US tech giant Microsoft says it has fixed problems that led to a global outage of its services. The glitch severely disrupted online communications in businesses and governments for more than 24 hours.

items.title: Trump, Xi and Putin to meet in China, White House says
items.summary: Trump is set to depart Washington on Monday for the Philippines, where he is due to attend a meeting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations before making his way to Shenzhen in China.

items.title: Hungary seizes $18m cash tied to ex-Orban-era minister in probe
items.summary: Anti-corruption authorities in Hungary say they found around $18 million in hidden cash.

items.title: Sudan: Misery worsens amid plummeting aid for displaced people
items.summary: Sudan's humanitarian crisis is exacerbated by cuts in international aid. Almost 34 million people are in need as war and drone strikes are making it difficult to deliver aid to the population.

items.title: Regular coffee drinking linked to changes in gut motility and microbiome
items.summary: The research team used a small electronic capsule that participants swallowed to monitor changes as it passed through the digestive system.
